quests.instruction: Look at the clue. Who is it?
quests.question: This person brings your food and drinks to your table.

quests.explanation: Yes! This is a waiter. Waiters bring food and drinks to your table at a restaurant.

quests.question: This person leads the crew and steers a big ship.
quests.hint: This person leads the crew and steers a big ship.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a ship captain. Ship captains lead the crew and steer a ship across the sea.
quests.funFact: A ship captain is responsible for everyone and everything on board!

quests.question: This person plays and mixes music to keep a party fun.
quests.hint: This person plays and mixes music to keep a party fun.
quests.explanation: Yes! This is a DJ. DJs play and mix music to keep a party or event fun.
quests.funFact: A DJ can blend two songs together so smoothly you barely notice!

quests.question: Firefighters practice climbing tall ladders to reach high windows.
quests.hint: Firefighters practice climbing tall ladders to reach high windows.
